name: cn-customer-service-scripts
description: Write customer service scripts (客服话术) for a Chinese online shop: pre-sale answers, payment reminders, order and logistics replies, returns and refunds, complaint and negative-review handling, with the consumer-rights and platform rules each script must respect. Use when asked 写客服话术, 售后话术怎么写, 催付话术, 客户要退货怎么回, 差评怎么处理, or build quick replies for our store's customer service team. Produces a script library by scenario with a first reply and follow-ups, an escalation rule, a banned-phrase list, and a quality checklist for supervisors. Distinct from support-macro style skills for Western help desks.
